text: raschke: "Parabolic distance from the average: exit territory, not entry". Not entry - agreed; sma_dist 46.6% is no buy point (C5). But C18's power play requires exactly this near-vertical thrust (run_10d 55.93%, rs_rank_pct 97.57) before a flag forms: the thrust is the precondition, the flag is the entry. My support is a watch on that flag, not a buy now. What drops me: a flag deeper than a quarter of the thrust, a pullback on rising volume (C6), or a daily close under ma20 36.34.
